name: Bunge
description: Bunge buys soybeans, canola, sunflower seed, grains and sugar from farmers, then stores, ships, crushes and refines them into protein meal for animal feed, vegetable oils for food makers and biofuel producers, and flour or sugar. It earns a thin margin per ton on huge volume (net sales $70.3B, segment EBIT $2.3B), so profit depends on crush margins, merchandising spreads and freight, not on selling a brand. On July 2, 2025 it acquired Viterra in a stock and cash deal, nearly doubling its grain merchandising business (segment sales +80%). It also finances farmers in Brazil to secure supply.

businessLines.name: Soybean Processing and Refining
businessLines.how: Buys soybeans and sells the meal (to feed makers and livestock producers) and oil (to food and biofuel companies) at a crush margin, plus farmer financing in Brazil.
businessLines.description: Soybean crushing into meal and oil, refining, biodiesel and fertilizer distribution; capacity 47% South America, 25% North America, 15% Asia-Pacific, 13% Europe.

businessLines.name: Softseed Processing and Refining
businessLines.how: Same crush-margin model on canola and sunflower; meal to feed makers, oil to food and biofuel buyers.
businessLines.description: Canola/rapeseed and sunflower seed crushing and refining; capacity 53% Europe, 30% North America, 13% South America, 4% Asia-Pacific.

businessLines.name: Other Oilseeds Processing and Refining
businessLines.how: Sells refined and specialty ingredients to bakers, snack and confectionery makers and food service, B2B and some B2C, priced on a margin over raw oil.
businessLines.description: Palm, palm kernel, coconut and shea oils, specialty fats and soy protein concentrates; includes 80% of the Loders joint venture with IOI.

businessLines.name: Grain Merchandising and Milling
businessLines.how: Earns a merchandising margin on grain bought from farmers and sold to feed makers, millers and exporters, plus freight and storage.
businessLines.description: Corn, wheat, barley, cotton, pulses and sugar trading, plus wheat and sugar milling (mainly South America) and ocean freight and financial services. North American corn milling sold in 2025.

brands.name: Loders (80% owned JV with IOI Corporation Berhad)
Bunge Iberica SA (40% sold to Repsol Mar 4, 2025; still consolidated)
Viterra Limited
brands.note: Acquired July 2, 2025; Glencore holds about 17%, CPP Investments 14% and BCIMC 3% of Bunge shares
